findings.claim: The fallback instruction for the known clippy baseline blocker cites a non-existent repository path.
findings.evidence: Plan says: "If the already-observed unchanged `librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs` baseline mismatch recurs..." but the file tree contains `./crates/librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs`, not `./librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs`; cited_paths also maps `librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs -> crates/librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs`.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the acceptance criterion to cite `crates/librefang-kernel-handle/src/test_stub.rs`.

findings.claim: One acceptance criterion is ambiguous because it relies on subjective wording rather than a mechanically checkable condition.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion says: "The scoped source contains no functional `started.elapsed() < ...` scheduler-performance assertion." The terms "scoped source" and "functional" are not defined, so implementers may disagree on which files and assertions are prohibited.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with explicit file and pattern checks, e.g. "In `crates/librefang-channels/src/uar_sidecar.rs`, remove assertions comparing `started.elapsed()` or equivalent elapsed wall-clock duration against millisecond upper bounds, except watchdog timeouts that only abort hung tests."
